column1: # Open-class stems, bulk-loaded into %lex Root via `%import lexicon.tsv`.
# Nouns carry <initial>=cons|vowel for a/an article agreement (NP -> Det N).
# Verbs need only <lemma>; their forms come from the V-reg paradigm in morph.gram.
# Future: the seed deliberately omits stems the current N-reg/V-reg paradigms
# misinflect under the boundary-free spelling cascade -- -y plurals (baby ->
# babies), sibilant plurals/3sg (box -> boxes, watch -> watches), -f/-fe (leaf ->
# leaves), and irregulars (man, foot, child). Those want dedicated paradigms
# (N-reg-y, N-reg-es, ...) before their stems can be added.
# `bark` is also a noun above, so morph_analyze returns both N and V for "bark".
